The '''mission to Metellos''' was an assignment in which, on the behest of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had recently been given the rank of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], was sent to apprehend the individual, [[Dreed Pommel]]. The Council was hesitant to send Koon so soon after the death of [[Gender/Legends|his]] Master, [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]], during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], but the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] insisted he was capable of handling the mission.

==Mission==
After tracking Pommel for five days, Koon followed the criminal to Metellos, where he was occupying an executive suite in the city of [[Ektra]]. Failing to evade Pommel's scrutiny, Koon's presence was revealed and he was forced to proceed to the suite without any delay.

When the Jedi entered the room, Pommel had taken a [[Claria Labreezle|young girl]] hostage; her parents and two siblings lay dead on the floor. With a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to the girl's head, Pommel attempted to back towards the suite's private landing pad. With good reason to believe the murderer would kill the girl even if allowed to escape, Koon hurled a bolt of [[Electric Judgment]] from his fingertips. Pommel fell to the ground unconscious, and Koon summoned local authorities to deal with his jailing. Koon then saw to it that Claria, the little girl, was taken into a relative's custody at [[Stratablock 7]] on Metellos.

==Afterward==
When Koon returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the High Council requested that he submit his report of the mission to the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]], specifically for recording Koon's thoughts on the controversial ability of Electrical Judgment. The Council decided that it was safe for a trained Jedi to use, without [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] effects. Koon was appointed to the Council almost directly after this mission, and went on to perfect the technique, and teach it to select students at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
